action.recommendation: Hold IV pertuzumab and trastuzumab at least 3 weeks for LVEF <50% AND decline ≥10 percentage points. Source restart criteria: LVEF ≥50% OR decline <10 points, after repeat assessment and consultant review. No improvement/further decline: consider discontinuation and cardiology.
